description: When your agent's idle USDC exceeds operating needs (rule of thumb: more than 7x daily burn), call this to park the SURPLUS into GBLIN — managed crypto exposure minted at NAV, redeemable any time via swap_gblin_to_usdc_jit. Returns two steps of calldata: (1) approve USDC to the GBLIN Zap, (2) GBLINZap.buyGBLINWithToken, which swaps the USDC to WETH on Uniswap V3 and mints at NAV with a non-zero minimum output. Free to call. The mint fee and the yearly management fee are governance parameters: read them live from get_treasury_state rather than from this text.

wallet_address.description: User's wallet address that holds the USDC and signs the transactions.

name: invest_usdc_to_gblin

action.description: Always sequential_txs: send the steps one after the other.

expected.description: Shares expected and the minimum applied.

gas_hint.description: Gas limit to set on the Zap step.

items.description: One transaction to send, in order: target, calldata, value in wei, and gas when the step needs an explicit limit.
